_README: Human-editable catalog consolidation overrides. The canonical catalog reconcile (scripts/catalog-canonical.ts) reads this every deploy. Edit it (or tell Claude in docs/CATALOG-NOTES.md and Claude edits it for you), then redeploy. Three kinds of override, all keyed by the product/catalog NAME exactly as it appears, or by a SiteOne item number. Names are matched case-insensitively and ignoring punctuation.

forceMerge._doc: Map a duplicate name OR item number -> the canonical product name to fold it into. Use for duplicates the automatic item-number/alias matching misses. The all-caps junk rows from the owner master live here.
forceMerge.LESCO L&O PALM 8-0-10 GRANULAR 50LB BAG: LESCO L&O Palm 8-0-10 Granular Fertilizer 50 lb. Bag
forceMerge.PT PI PRESSURIZED CONTACT INSECTICIDE 14: PT PI Pressurized Contact Insecticide 14 oz
forceMerge.LESCO CROSSCHECK PL Granular insecticide: LESCO Crosscheck 0.069% 0-0-7 AM Insecticide Plus Fertilizer 50 lb.

keepSeparate._doc: Pairs of canonical names that must NEVER be merged, even if something tries. Belt-and-suspenders for genuinely-different look-alikes.
pairs: LESCO Crosscheck 0.069% 0-0-7 AM Insecticide Plus Fertilizer 50 lb.
LESCO Crosscheck 0.096% 21-0-10 Insecticide Plus Fertilizer 50 lb.
LESCO Crosscheck 0.069% 0-0-7 AM Insecticide Plus Fertilizer 50 lb.
LESCO Crosscheck Plus Liquid Insecticide 1 gal.
LESCO Crosscheck 0.096% 21-0-10 Insecticide Plus Fertilizer 50 lb.
LESCO Crosscheck Plus Liquid Insecticide 1 gal.

rename._doc: Override the display name of a canonical product. Key = current canonical name, value = the name you want shown.
rename.example LESCO Crosscheck Plus Liquid Ins: LESCO Crosscheck Plus Liquid Insecticide 1 gal.
